items.title: Robert Williams III on what he thinks about Ja Morant:"Man, I fuck with Ja. Look, I tried not to curse, but I got to say it. You know, since he came in, day one, bro, from communication, work ethic, to just relying on teammates and us relying on him, he accepted everything..."
items.author: MrBuckBuck
items.body_excerpt: Full quote: "Man, I fuck with Ja. Look, I tried not to curse, but I got to say it. You know, since he came in, day one, bro, from communication, work ethic, to just relying on teammates and us relying on him, he accepted everything, you know, and we can see he is ready to work."

items.title: Robert Williams III: "I went through a lot of injuries. Just happy to be back playing. I'm glad it's in Portland." Says he's still working through the plan for the season with the medical staff but doesn't anticipate as many minutes restrictions as he had last year.
